text: Lady Karandra Fordring was the wife of Lord Paladin Tirion Fordring of Hearthglen.

Kaskala is a ruined tuskarr port located in the eastern coast of the Borean Tundra. It was once the former tuskarr capital, and used to be the biggest of their ports, until the kvaldir longships came sailing out of the mists and the slaughter began. The survivors fled east to Unu'pe, where many of them still are. Kaskala is home to many of the carved stone statues that house the spirits of long-gone tuskarr elders, and that alone makes the invasion of the kvaldir more difficult for them to bear. Katoom the Angler is a forest troll fishing trainer and fishing vendor located in Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.
Karn Stonehoof is a tauren blacksmithing trainer located at Karn's Smithy on the lower rise in Thunder Bluff.
__NOTOC__ Kania is a night elf enchanting vendor located at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. She is located upstairs at the inn.

Lord Karramyn Langston was the protégé of Lieutenant General Aedelas Blackmoore, master of Durnholde Keep, and served as the general's second in command — by being a simpering sycophant, always in Blackmoore's shadow. He did not always agree with his master but was too much of a coward to say anything. Once, Prince Arthas Menethil visited Durnholde and had a dinner with Aedelas and Karramyn. The prince immediately began to dislike the protégé. When Thrall escaped, Karramyn was informing Aedelas when someone saw his pet. When the liberation of the orcs started, Karramyn was appointed with leading the fifth internment camp. However, he was not able to fight and Thrall managed to capture him. W
Kar Stormsinger is a tauren kodo riding trainer located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.
__NOTOC__ Karrel Grayves is a ghoul found at a roadside camp northeast of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
Kargal Battlescar is an orc quest giver located at Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens. He defended the Post during the Legion invasions.
__NOTOC__ Karl Boran is a human quest giver located in Menethil Harbor in the Alliance-aligned zone of Wetlands.
Karnitol's Chest is a chest found on the shores near Ethel Rethor of Desolace.

Kargathia Keep (or Kargathia Outpost) is located in eastern Ashenvale, in the eastern part of the Warsong Lumber Camp just west of the Southfury River. It is the base of operations for the officers of the Warsong Clan, and has a strategic position that lets it receive reinforcements from Orgrimmar should a battle with the Alliance break out. The keep, much like Kargath in the Badlands, and Bladefist Bay in Durotar, is named for the legendary orcish hero Kargath Bladefist. Overseer Gorthak, the orc in charge of the camp, can be found here. The building is a stronghold and is seemingly upgraded with spiked barricades.
Karang Amakkar is an orc quest giver located at the Hellscream's Watch in Ashenvale. He was formerly located in Zoram'gar Outpost.
__NOTOC__ Katar is an orc located at Misty Reed Post in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Kaskk is a rare felguard found at Mannoroc Coven in Desolace.
Kashoch the Reaver is a rare ice giant found in Winterspring.

Karna Remtravel is a dwarf quest giver located at the entrance to Marshal's Refuge in the Un'Goro Crater. She may be related to Prospector Remtravel. She tells players that she has an "uncle Remtravel" who she is kinda following in the footsteps of and he likes old stuff and cultures too.

__NOTOC__ Kavaan is a draenei paladin trainer located at the Vindicators' Sanctum in the Vault of Lights in the Exodar. Following the death of Tirion Fordring, Kavaan joined the Silver Hand and is located in the Sanctum of Light. During the Battle for the Exodar, he was inside Velen's protective shield.
Kayaart is a draenei located at the Trader's Tier in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, she was inside Velen's protective shield.
Karaaz is a Consortium ethereal reputation rewards vendor located at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm. He appears to be a bit unscrupulous in his dealings.

Karabor Training Grounds sends the players to the Ruins of Karabor to investigate the increasing numbers of Sunfury blood elves.

The Karazhan raid instance is located in the abandoned citadel (or castle) of the same name, which is located in southern Deadwind Pass in the Eastern Kingdoms. This raid was designed for level 70 characters and opened near the beginning of World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade. The raid is a single huge wing (containing seven stories and 17 map pages) containing both the lower guest complex and upper tower, with some shortcuts. It encompasses twelve boss encounters, some scripted with different possibilities per week from 22 different NPCs. While the layout is largely non-linear, there are four essential bosses: Moroes, the Opera Event, The Curator, and the Chess Event. These four must be

Karrog is one of four descendants of Terokk's ancient enemies who are being held prisoner by the Skettis talonpriests. You learn of their existence from a tome called Adversarial Bloodlines. Originally, you were asked to retrieve Karrog's Spine if you intended to summon and defeat Terokk. Open a skull pile at one of the red summoning portals in Skettis. If you have 10 Time-Lost Scrolls then you will be presented with a list of names. Select "Karrog". The scrolls will be expended and Karrog will appear in a flash of lightning.

Karune, aternatively known as Karunecm (real name Kevin Yu) on the World of Warcraft forums, is a Blizzard employee and RTS Community Manager (US Battle.net Starcraft 2 [http://www.battle.net/forums/ forums], as well as the Starcraft 2 boards on the World of Warcraft forums). The avatar is a Starcraft 2 High Templar unit.
Karaborian Battle Axe is a random drop in Hellfire Ramparts.

The Kargath Expeditionary Force (K.E.F.) is a military exploration group originally based out of the outpost of Kargath in the Badlands of Khaz Modan. It was named in honor of the great Horde warrior, Kargath Bladefist.
Kataru can be found in Zangarmarsh. He is the leader of the worst of all the traitor tribes of Lost Ones, the Umbrafen tribe. Ikeyen wants him slain for The Umbrafen Tribe.
__NOTOC__ Karrtog is a Mag'har orc quest giver located in Garadar in Nagrand.
Karazhan had a bailey, which was often used as a living area by farmers or slaves, which might explain the village adjacent to it.
__NOTOC__ Karuk is a tuskarr located just north of Riplash Strand in the Borean Tundra.

Karkut appears to be a tuskarr deity who is also known as "he who watches over the dead". According to Ataika, death knights such as Thassarian bear his mark. Karkut is said to watch over fallen tuskarr so they do not lose their way. The tuskarr believe that Karkut's spirit is currently walking the earth, gathering the spirits of dead tuskarr. Karkut awaits the spirits of dead tuskarr as they pass on.
Kaskala Supplies can be found on the grounds of Kaskala and in the water of Njord's Breath Bay in the Borean Tundra.

__NOTOC__ Karen "I Don't Caribou" the Culler is a Forsaken found on the bluff above the Farshire Mine just to the north of Farshire in southern Borean Tundra with two stealthed Loot Crazed Poachers as guards.

They can be freed with Core of Malice dropped from the hounds while on the following quest: *The Lost Spirits

Kaskala Shaman was a tuskarr slain by the invading Beryl Reclaimers and Beryl Treasure Hunters, their spirits now roam the Coldrock Quarry of Borean Tundra, tormented by the Beryl Hounds. They can be freed with Core of Malice dropped from the hounds while on the following quest: *The Lost Spirits

Kartak's Hold is an outpost of the Frenzyheart Tribe in the far southwestern corner of Sholazar Basin. They are at constant war with the gorlocs of Sparktouched Haven. It is here they worship Kartak the Abominable.

Katricia aka Donna Anthony was a Blizzard employee and was a Community Manager for the US World of Warcraft [http://us.battle.net/wow/en/forum/ forums] during the Classic Beta. She received a tribute to her in the form of a vendor, Donni Anthania.
Katherine Lee is a Grand Master cooking trainer located at the A Hero's Welcome inn in Dalaran, inside the kitchen.
Kanosak is a tuskarr dockmaster located at Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight.
__NOTOC__ Karandonna is a high elf shirt vendor located at Runeweaver Square in Dalaran over Northrend. During the purge of Dalaran, she was sitting behind a changing curtain.
__NOTOC__ Katja is a quest giver located at Silverbrook in the Grizzly Hills. Though she appears human, she is actually a worgen and a member of the Wolfcult.

The Karabor Sewers are part of the Black Temple, entered from under the Ruins of Karabor. It is here that the last of Illidan's Coilskar naga thrive, their leader High Warlord Naj'entus watching over them. The sewers were originally the gateway for Lady Vashj's naga armies during the assault on the Black Temple.
Kargath Grunts are orcs that guarded Kargath in the Badlands.
__NOTOC__ Kavina Grovesong is an Alliance balance druid and is one of the possible opponents for Horde in the Faction Champions battle in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance.

__NOTOC__ Kaye Toogie is an undead member of the Kirin Tor found at the bottom of a grate-covered well just outside of The Filthy Animal. She can only be reached by using the Wormhole Generator: Northrend and selecting Underground.
Kanika Goldwell was a goblin arena organizer located in the Underbelly underneath Dalaran.

Karlee Chaddis and her children Gil and Paige Chaddis take an extended tour of Stormwind. All the while Gil impatiently asks "" They do have a destination: Ancient Curios in the Mage Quarter. While there Karlee orders some goods from Charys, the reagent vendor, while Gil claims Fizzles the bunny was once a great wizard who had a spell go disastrously wrong. __NOTOC__
Kathis was one of the dwarves under Rom's command. He accompanied him to a mission to capture a skardyn. During the mission, he and Albrech perished.
Karsh Steelbender is the third boss of Blackrock Caverns in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm. He is a twilight drakonid.

__NOTOC__ Karnum Marshweaver is a tauren quest giver located in Karnum's Glade, Desolace. He is a member of the Cenarion Circle. Since Battle for Azeroth, players can speak to Karnum Marshweaver to receive the reputation reward for the Magram Clan Centaur and Gelkis Clan Centaur factions, if they have already finished Death to Agogridon prior to patch 8.0.1.

Karizi Porkpatty is a goblin located at Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara. She used to reside in Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar, but was moved to Azshara following the construction of Orgrimmar Embassy along with Zarbo Porkpatty, who might be her husband. Despite still being titled as cooking supplies vendor, she no longer sells anything.

Kark Helmbreaker is a goblin blacksmithing trainer located at Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara. He used to reside in Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar, but was moved to Azshara following the construction of Orgrimmar Embassy. He can still be seen there before allied races are unlocked.
Kargal's Breastplate is a quest reward from The Far Watch Offensive.

__NOTOC__ Karoma is a spirit beast found in the Twilight Highlands. It is modeled after spirit wolves that shaman can summon. Hunters with Exotic Beasts can tame it. It is one of the 2 spirit beasts to have a title, the other being the panther Loque'nahak. It is the only hostile spirit beast, the rest being neutral. Interestingly, Karoma is also one of the 2 rare tamable mobs that roam the Twilight Highlands, the other being the lion Sambas, who is found in the northern part of the highlands, while Karoma is found around the Devouring Breach (east of Bloodgulch, northeast of the Crucible of Carnage, south and southeast of Firebeard's Patrol) and south and southeast of the Dunwald Ruins.

Karren Dresner is a level 52 alchemy vendor in the inn in the Sludge Fields of Hillsbrad Foothills. She was rescued by an adventurer during the Legion invasion, afterwards lamenting the death of someone.
__NOTOC__ Karranisha is an orc hunter trainer located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

Kartak the Abominable is summoned by Oracle Blood during the quest Kartak's Rampage.
Karkin is a large rare crab who makes a living on the rocks around Fireplume Peak in the Molten Front.

Karr'gonn is an ogre that can be found at the Seat of the Chosen in Mount Hyjal having an important meeting with High Cultist Azennios. He must be distracted via the use of an :Ogre Disguise in order for players to be able to kill the High Cultist for the quest Seeds of Discord.
__NOTOC__ Karn Cragcare is a Dark Iron dwarf stable master located at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

Kathrena Winterwisp is a night elf quest giver at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore. She later becomes a garrison follower, recruitable at random from the Lunarfall Inn. She was present at the Grove of the Ancients when the Horde invaded it during the War of the Thorns.

and (samurai swords or Japanese swords) are one of the many forms of swords and daggers. But behind stats, katana and wakizashi are very desirable for their appearance. They are often used by SI:7 agents.

Kari the Beastmaster is a frost vrykul stable master found in the Brunnhildar Village of the Storm Peaks. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, she joined the Unseen Path in the Trueshot Lodge, though she remains unfriendly. She was also seen in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.

Kara'din was a night elf druid sent by Malfurion Stormrage to Ashenvale with Parsis, in order to bring the night elven race closer together. He fought with Haldrissa Woodshaper's army against the Horde. He healed them as best as he could. Later on Haldrissa learned from Denea that Kara'din was focused on healing the wounded, and failed to protect himself in time from a hail of arrows.
Karazhan Guild Run is a guild achievement that is awarded for defeating the final boss of the Karazhan raid while in a guild group.

Katak the Defeated is a yaungol imprisoned at Fire Camp Osul in Townlong Steppes. In the aftermath of Gong Da's defeat, he challenged Jung Duk for leadership of the Osul tribe, but was defeated through treachery. Three of his fellow tribesmen, once his brothers, betrayed him; Battat, who slipped a dagger into his side, Ku-Tong, who bent his spear, and Urang, who poisoned his drink. He heckles Jung Duk when he is challenged, and is relieved by his death.
__NOTOC__ Karkrog the Exterminator is a Dragonmaw orc patrolling in the Thundermar Ruins in the Twilight Highlands.
Kaydee Threesong is a pandaren found inside the tavern at Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle.

He and Omasum Blighthoof are guarding the entrance to Stratholme. They received a letter from Baroness Anastari, claiming that if they keep the plaguewoods secured, they would earn a new comrade.

He was followed to Karazhan not only by the druid adventurer, but also by a warlock adventurer seeking Ulthalesh, the Deadwind Harvester, a death knight adventurer seeking Apocalypse, and the priest Revil Kost who had dealt with the Dark Riders before. The Shado-Pan followed the mogu to Zandalar and spied on them at Warport Rastari. When Zul and Mythrax attacked Zuldazar, Kao-Tien units accompanied them.

Kattik Sharktasted is the catch master for Taruka's clan of tuskarr. He retired from daily fishing when he lost his right eye, a hand, and a leg to a shark, hence his surname. His eyebrows are twice as bushy as anyone else's, and lack of cleaning has made his tusks so yellow that the etched clan and family symbols can't be seen. Everything about Kattik is huge, from his eyebrows, tusks, and moustache to his sense of self-importance. He regularly exchanges insults with the butcher Larati; according to her, the catch master dislikes anything new or young. Kathos Ren is a Maldraxxi gladiator located in the Seat of the Primus.

Karaxi the Defector is a Maldraxxi necromancer located in the Challenger's Promenade in Maldraxxus. She had been exiled from Thran'tiok's service and the House of Rituals due to the lich's paranoia. After getting aid in her revenge against her former master from the Maw Walker serving the Kyrian Covenant, she appears in a building at the Forgotten Wounds where she defeats an Image of Thran'tiok and frees the Maw Walker. After they extract the memory from the Phylactery of Pain, Karaxi takes it and leaves.
__NOTOC__ Kanyaku is a jungle troll located in Orgrimmar Skyway in Orgrimmar. He is one of Zaa'je's workers and tried to steal Shiri's Shipment.

Karash may refer to: * Karash, a deceased Frostwolf orc known in-game as the "Young Orc Traveler". * Pridelord Karash, a historical leader of the Bloodmane saberon who was killed by Terokk. * Karash, a former MVP forum poster on the official German forums.

The enchanted keepers of the grove (or keepers of the glade) are the male offspring of the demigod Cenarius who protect the woodlands of Azeroth. Sometimes, the keepers make use of the Emerald Dream in their duties.

The Keeper of storms shrine was an in-game secret in the Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne mission "Wrath of the Betrayer." On the north-western isle of the Broken Isles, the naga defended the Keeper of storms shrine to the right one of their bases. It was presumably a shrine built by the ancient night elves. Maiev could only get there by blinking. It was defended by a Naga Royal Guard and a Massive Ruined Gate. There were 1500 in gold coins there, next to what was presumably a statue of the Keeper of storms.
Keenclaw is Swiftwing's mate, one of the mightiest gryphons of Aerie Peak. She is the mother of Sharpbeak.

The Keeper of storms was a deity or hero seemingly worshiped by the naga at the Keeper of storms shrine on one of the Broken Isles. Interestingly, the Keeper of storms seemingly looks identical to one of the keepers of the grove, though the statue may be ruined and not all of the features may be visible. It is possible, and likely, that the shrine and the statue were built by the night elves who lived here before the Great Sundering, rather than by the naga themselves.
Keldas is a night elf pet trainer located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
__NOTOC__ Kayla Smithe is a Forsaken warlock located in Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
__NOTOC__ Keeper Ordanus is a keeper of the grove found in Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale.
__NOTOC__ Kayneth Stillwind is a night elf quest giver located at Forest Song in Ashenvale.

Keeper Bel'varil is a Forsaken quest giver located in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He assists Wordeen Voidglare in his research. He came to the center of the town to see the arrival of Orkus and Kasha. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

Kazkaz the Unholy is a jungle troll found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Although named, he had no associated quests, and he had the same loot table as the various trash mobs of the temple.
The Keg of Shindigger Stout is located in Dun Garok in Hillsbrad Foothills.
__NOTOC__ Keilnei is a draenei hunter trainer located at the Crash Site in Azuremyst Isle.
__NOTOC__ Kazi is a draenei warrior trainer located in Trader's Tier in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, she was inside Velen's protective shield.
__NOTOC__ Kayra Longmane is a tauren quest giver located at Umbrafen Village in Zangarmarsh.

Keg of Thunderbrew Lager is a quest reward from Thunderbrew Lager, an exchange of five hops for one Keg of Thunderbrew Lager. The quest is either repeatable or has a repeatable counterpart; in any event, the five hops turn-in is repeatable. This is a good thing because you are likely to stumble on the source quest in Westfall and consume the item for the buffs before you get the quest in Redridge for which it is an objective.
Kaylari Shoulders are a quest reward from Prayer to Elune (2).
The third boss in the Battle for Mount Hyjal, Kaz'rogal is a rather tough DPS race.

Keleth is an ancient of war found in Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh. When asked he'll provide a buff that lasts 30 minutes, which only remains while in Zangarmarsh. Buff improves along with Cenarion Expedition reputation.
Keefer's Angelfish can be fished from Schools of Tastyfish during the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza. Roughly 1 in every 200 items fished from Schools of Tasyfish will be a Keefer's Angelfish.
Kayser's Boots of Precision are a pair of Level 55 quality Cloth Boots that improve Intellect, Stamina and Critical Strike.

__NOTOC__ Kaylaan is a draenei quest giver located at Tuluman's Landing in the Netherstorm. While fighting Socrethar at Socrethar's Seat on the Aldor side players will face Kaylaan the Lost, as a mob, the same character turned evil after leaving the Aldor.
Keen Marshfang Slicer is a quest reward from Lines of Communication (Zangarmarsh) and The Sharpest Blades.
The Keepsake of Remembrance is a personal item belonging to the lich Ras Frostwhisper and is used to restore his mortality.
Kel'gash the Wicked can be found in Ghostlands. He is the chieftain of the Shadowpine trolls.
The Keeper of the Rolls was a human found at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

A keelboat is a 50- to 75-foot-long ship that is 15 to 20 feet wide and has a few oars to supplement its single mast with a square sail. It has a crew of 8 to 15 and can carry forty to fifty tons of cargo or 100 soldiers. It can make sea voyages as well as sail down rivers. (It has a flat bottom.) It moves about 1 mile per hour.
Keen Machete drops from Threggil, a rare spawn grell at Fel Rock in Teldrassil.
Keb'ezil is the minion of Kurgatok, and can be found at Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest.
Kayri is a draenei armor vendor in the Sun's Reach Armory of the Isle of Quel'Danas. She sells Veteran's PvP gear in exchange for gold and Vindicator's PvP gear for Tier 6 loot tokens.
The Keepers of Time Tabard is worn by the Keepers of Time faction in the Caverns of Time. It is also given to their most trusted allies.

Keiran Donoghue is a sausage vendor available to Alliance players during the activities of Brewfest. He sells the sausages needed for The Brewfest Diet.
Kearnen's Journal is provided as an objective for Klaven's Tower (quest).
Keeper Witherleaf is a Keeper of the Grove who wanders the Twisted Glade, in Howling Fjord.

Kel'Thuzad's Chamber is the final room of Naxxramas and the inner sanctum of its dread master. It is only reachable after defeating Sapphiron.

Kekek, the Wolvar Orphan can be found on the small planter behind Orphan Matron Aria during Children's Week in the Eventide district of Dalaran. Three Wolvar Orphans are taunting the Oracle Orphan by playing keep-away with the Oracle's toy. He'll eventually grow up to be Elder Kekek and lead his people home.

The Keep Cannon is a siege defense device that uses the vehicle interface in the Isle of Conquest battleground. They are found on top of the outer towers of the Alliance Keep and Horde Keep, with each tower hosting six cannons.
